series_description: The forty-year story of The Stardust Engine (1978–2018), told in third-person limited perspective through the eyes of lead guitarist Ryan O'Connell—from the sonic frequencies of Blacksburg High School and Aunt Martha Wright's farmhouse on Progress Street NE, through the 1990 highway crash at Mile Marker 98 and the 1992 Friction catastrophe in Los Angeles, to the 2016 homecoming concert inside The Crucible and the 2018 Nine-Figure Refusal.

images.alt: December 14, 1990 (DEC 14 '90) at Star City General Hospital in Roanoke: on the first night Ryan is cleared for an overnight visitor, twenty-three-year-old Cassidy O'Connell (right, in her Burnt Orange CPI sweatshirt beside the brown vinyl overnight sleeper-recliner and folded patchwork quilt from home) leans in to kiss and hold her twenty-six-year-old brother Ryan O'Connell (left) as snow falls outside the night window.

December 18, 1990 (DEC 18 '90) at Star City General Hospital: eight days after the crash, twenty-one-year-old Holly O'Connell (left, in Burnt Orange CPI t-shirt) and twenty-three-year-old Cassidy O'Connell (right, in Burnt Orange CPI t-shirt) hug their twenty-six-year-old brother Ryan O'Connell (center, seated in a hospital wheelchair with heather-gray sweatpants and a folded navy-and-tan plaid blanket covering his lap and legs) before taking him for his first fifteen-minute lap around the medical ward.

December 19, 1990 (DEC 19 '90) at Star City General Hospital: surrounded by the family circle—front row, left to right: Cassidy O'Connell (age 23, in gray knit sweater), Ryan O'Connell (age 26, center, in Foundry Maroon sweatshirt), and Holly O'Connell (age 21, in red-and-navy plaid flannel shirt holding the black three-ring Protocol T-10 binder in her lap); back row, left to right: identical twenty-two-year-old twin cousins Evan Wright (in green-and-navy plaid flannel) and Tyler Wright (in red-and-navy plaid flannel).

parts.image_alt: From the Section 104, Row A accessible terrace inside The Crucible at night, fans cheer up at a sweeping cinema camera jib overhead while on the main stage all 300 members of the CPI Marching Forgers perform alongside Ryan and Cassidy O'Connell under molten-orange and foundry-maroon spotlights.

images.alt: From the Section 104, Row A accessible terrace inside The Crucible at night, fans cheer up at a sweeping cinema camera jib overhead while on the main stage all 300 members of the CPI Marching Forgers perform alongside Ryan and Cassidy O'Connell under molten-orange and foundry-maroon spotlights.

On stage inside The Crucible during 'The Stardust Engine', Ryan O'Connell plays a soaring lead on his sunburst electric guitar from his manual wheelchair on stage-left while Cassidy O'Connell sings and plays her wraparound analog synthesizer rig at center-right, backed by Evan Wright, Tyler Wright, and the 300 uniformed brass and percussionists of the CPI Marching Forgers under deep cosmic-violet nebula projections.

images.alt: Inside The Crucible at night during 'Fifty-Two to Nothing: The Norfolk Reckoning', massive glowing Foundry Maroon and Molten Orange numerals on the North End Zone scoreboard display 'CPI 52 — VDU 0' while down on the Section 104, Row A accessible terrace, fans cheer wildly.

Cassidy O'Connell stands fiercely at the front edge of The Crucible stadium stage in a black leather jacket over a maroon CPI Alumni shirt, gripping a tilted microphone stand and belting 'Not Your Doll' while Ryan O'Connell shreds on his sunburst electric guitar from his manual wheelchair beside her and crimson pyrotechnics erupt behind them.

parts.image_alt: Inside The Crucible during 'Neon on the Huckleberry Trail', a 120-foot curved LED screen projects an autumn sunset over the narrow paved Huckleberry rail-trail between wooden split-rail pasture fences while Ryan O'Connell plays his sunburst electric guitar from his manual wheelchair and Cassidy O'Connell steps back from her microphone with her hand over her heart; at the Section 104, Row A railing in the foreground, Walter 'Santa Walt' Pendleton (the locally famous real-bearded New River Valley Mall Santa and 1956 CPI alumnus in a maroon flat cap) wipes joyful tears, Jordan Fuller smiles in his wheelchair in his Foundry Maroon CPI shirt holding Aubrie Jean Kelly's hand alongside Madison Scott, Zoë Wren Brooks, and Mark Anderson, and a bewildered out-of-towner in a blue polo looks around in amazement.
